rooms.name: Causeway
rooms.description: A wave-washed stone causeway joining the rock to the shore road. Gulls cry in the dark.

rooms.name: Galley
rooms.description: A cramped warm galley. Flour dusts every surface; bread rises under a cloth.

rooms.name: Bunkroom
rooms.description: Two narrow bunks, a sea-chest, and a coat hook. A ledger lies open on the blanket.

rooms.name: Lamp Room
rooms.description: The great lamp, cold and dark. The oil store stands empty; an oily footprint marks the stair.
